name: Pathways to Potential
organisation: Community Platform Together CIC and The Branch
status: Live - grant-funded project (status not stated in the pathways document)
whoFor: Economically inactive people who want to improve wellbeing, build confidence and move closer to volunteering, training or work, including people facing long-term health conditions, disability, mental health challenges, caring, addiction, debt, risk of homelessness, the criminal justice system or isolation.
locations: The Branch, Jubilee Centre, Huddersfield, HD1 4SH - a welcoming, accessible community space
eligibility: Economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)
referralRoutes: Referral through partner organisations in the community

activities.name: Pathways to Potential Programme
activities.summary: Group workshops and one-to-one guidance covering wellbeing and mindfulness, digital confidence and basic IT skills (including AI), CVs, job searching and interviews, and volunteering and community connections.
activities.duration: 10 sessions over eight weeks (three cohorts, 30 places in total)

provenance.source: Kirklees HWL Pathways Aug 26 v2.1 (draft 15 Sept 2026; grant-funded schemes added 12 Oct 2026)

listing.reason: Healthy Working Life scheme, on the live list from the start.
